title: Battle of Preßnitz
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Preßnitz", at revision 1370272287, opens: "The Battle of Preßnitz was a military engagement fought on 27 March [O.S. 17 March] 1641 during the Thirty Years' War. In the battle, Imperial troops under Octavio Piccolomini defeated the Swedish army under Field Marshal Johan Baner." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q20966109, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1641 battle of the thirty years' war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
